requirements.text: Significant professional experience delivering production software as a full-stack engineer or in a closely related senior engineering position.
Strong capability across both client-side and server-side development, with sound understanding of modern web application architecture.
Proven experience designing maintainable APIs, integrating services, and working with data persistence and distributed application concerns.
Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions while balancing product outcomes, user experience, reliability, and delivery speed.
Demonstrated success owning complex initiatives from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, and improvement.
Working knowledge of automated testing, version control, deployment workflows, monitoring, and production support practices.
Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
A collaborative, accountable approach to code review, feedback, mentoring, and shared responsibility for software quality.

The position is based in San Francisco, California, and suits an engineer who is comfortable moving between product detail and system-level thinking. Experience with marketplace, consumer services, mobile applications, or operationally complex platforms would be valuable, although strong full-stack engineering fundamentals remain central.
